dedup.note: Content-hub collapse: Figma Blog posted three Figma-agent pieces at the same time on 2026-10-06 (3 ways / design-system upkeep / Workflow lab). I kept only the '3 ways' post because it carries the general-availability news. The Workflow-lab post is also a recurring series (the Weave edition ran 10-02). Dropped as already published: Vectorworks 2027 (same release as engineering.com 2026-09-19, and AI only incidental); Meta Muse 'cute agent' essay (same story as Fast Company 'Muse Charm kawaii era' 2026-09-27); taste-paradox essay (theme already run as Fast Company 'having good taste won't save designers' 2026-09-23 and the UX Collective skill-atrophy piece 2026-10-06; also dropped yesterday); Photoshop Relight hands-on (probably the same tool as Creative Bloq's 'controversial new AI tool' 2026-10-01, so treated as a follow-up with no new release). Dropped as off-scope or noise: Volve AI tendering and OpenSpace job-site agents (construction ops, not design; OpenSpace was also dropped yesterday), Mistral Large 4 (general model news), TechCrunch AI-agents-vs-websites (not design), OpenAI image-gen ads (ad business), Google Flow Music plugins (belongs in the music section, cross-section clash risk). Photoshop 27.11 is a new version with its own new AI features (Enhance Edge, GPT Image 2 model choice), so it is a separate story from the 10-06 Remove-tool credits tip. The Claude Code to Figma test covers code-to-canvas push, the opposite direction to the 09-08 Figma Make to Claude Code handoff. Outlets: Figma, CG Channel, Fast Company, DEV x2 (4 distinct, cap 2 respected). Categories: figma 2, render 1, workflow 2.

items.rationale: The Figma agent is now generally available; Uber, Granola and Atlassian show how product designers use it for craft and speed, which makes it the most actionable release of the day.
items.excerpt: Here’s how teams at Uber, Granola, and Atlassian support high-quality, fast-moving work with the Figma agent, now generally available.

items.rationale: New Photoshop release: AI Enhance Edge cleans colour fringing in Remove Background masks (20 credits per use), and GPT Image 2 can now be chosen for Generate Image and Prompt to edit.
items.excerpt: Photoshop 27.11 adds Enhance Edge, an AI option (20 generative credits per use) that reduces colour fringing in Remove Background masks, and lets users pick OpenAI's GPT Image 2 for Generate Image and Prompt to edit.

items.rationale: A product-design case study: Hark Pro's designers rethought what an agentic assistant should do and put privacy and usefulness first, which gives designers of AI products a usable reference.
items.excerpt: With a chatbot interface and agentic capabilities, Hark Pro checks the boxes of a 2026 AI release, but its designers rethought the core premise of how an assistant should help, prioritising privacy and usefulness.

items.rationale: A week-long hands-on test of pushing live Claude Code output into editable Figma frames, with clear advice on when it beats screenshots, so it applies directly to design-to-code handoff.
items.excerpt: Figma now lets you push live code from Claude directly into editable frames. I tested it for a week. Here's when it's worth using and when screenshots work

items.rationale: A first-hand account of a former Figma expert's practice: they now describe sites, apps and video ads to an agent (Claude Opus 5) that builds them, a concrete picture of how the designer's role is changing.
items.excerpt: A designer who once called themself a Figma expert explains how their practice shifted: describing websites, apps and video ads to an agent (Claude Opus 5) that builds them, while Figma adds its own agent.
